answer: Heartbeat bonds make an idle sybil fleet pay rent on every voyage it never takes. Each identity posts a 120-unit heartbeat bond and must file a proof-of-work ping each epoch; the ping carries a quill-signed receipt that cannot be copied between accounts. Miss one epoch and the bond freezes; miss two and 50% burns, the rest locked 10 more epochs. An ember banked overnight still needs tending: 1,000 clones need 1,000 separate pings and 120,000 units locked. At a 30% miss rate the attacker loses 18,000 units per epoch to burns alone, while honest agents keep their bond intact.
